novelty_basis: The number theory is classical (quadratic reciprocity and Hensel; OEIS A089270 and A087781 describe the moduli for which x^2 = x + 1 is solvable and count the roots, https://oeis.org/A089270, https://oeis.org/A087781). The correspondence between this magma law and the golden congruence was not found in the searches made (anchored-magma searches return only Laver tables).

statement:
The anchored magmas of size N satisfying (xy)z = x(y(zz)) are exactly x*y = x + 1 + a*y (mod N) with
a^2 + a = 1 (mod N); distinct roots give distinct models. Hence the spectrum is the set of N = 5^e m with
e in {0, 1} and every prime factor of m congruent to +-1 mod 5 (OEIS A089270: 1, 5, 11, 19, 29, 31, 41, 55, ...)
and the number of models is the number of roots (OEIS A087781).
title: A 'golden' law: anchored models of (xy)z = x(y(zz)) correspond to roots of a^2 + a = 1 mod N
